issues.body: The Reference conversion still calls into_iri(raw), and the generated reference type still stores only a String documented as an IRI. SHACL sh:class applies to value nodes, including blank nodes: a blank node with rdf:type C (directly or through rdfs:subClassOf*) can conform. This loader rejects that valid value with TermType before ValueSource::is_instance_of can evaluate membership. The real-path harness still exercises classified and unclassified named nodes only, so it does not catch the narrowing. This is the same major correctness gap reported in round 4.
issues.fix_hint: Represent a class reference as a node identity that preserves NamedNode versus BlankNode, accept both node kinds in the sh:class conversion while rejecting literals, and change is_instance_of and ClassMembership reporting accordingly. Add compiled-harness cases proving that a classified blank node loads and an unclassified blank node is rejected.
issues.title: sh:class still rejects blank-node value nodes

verdict.summary: Round 5 leaves the prior major correctness issue unchanged. The emitted sh:class conversion still calls into_iri(raw), and the generated reference newtype still represents only an IRI String. SHACL sh:class applies to value nodes, including blank nodes, so a blank node with rdf:type C (directly or through rdfs:subClassOf*) must be eligible to conform. The loader rejects it with TermType before ValueSource::is_instance_of can decide membership. The compiled harness still covers classified and unclassified named nodes only and has no blank-node sh:class cases. This is materially the same major finding at the same severity, so progress is stagnant.
